contract_ref: NODE-TRANSPORT-v1: GET /v1/node/health must return status 'ok' for healthy transport

derivation_chain.step: Rust MCP protocol does not implement /api/health endpoint

finding.title: Health endpoint missing — /api/health returns 404
finding.description: The Rust MCP protocol on port 3457 does not implement the /api/health endpoint that the Swift MCP server exposes on port 3456. The health check returns HTTP 404.
finding.invariant_violated: NODE-TRANSPORT-v1 requires a health endpoint that returns status 'ok' for healthy transport
finding.impact: Health monitoring cannot verify Rust MCP protocol health via HTTP GET
finding.note: This is a finding against the Rust MCP protocol, not against QA-Pilot. The Rust protocol uses diagnostic methods via JSON-RPC instead.

recommendation.description: Either implement /api/health endpoint on the Rust MCP protocol, or document that health checking uses the diagnostic_methods available via JSON-RPC (status, health)
recommendation.proposed_action: Owner decision required — which health check mechanism is canonical?
